scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently and wanted to see where things stand.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-01079, has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh, no. That's disappointing to hear. Can you tell me why my application was denied?
dialogue.agent: The primary reason your application was denied is that the credit application was incomplete.

dialogue.user: Incomplete? I thought I provided all the necessary documentation. What information was missing?
dialogue.agent: The record indicates that the credit application was incomplete, but it does not specify which particular documents or information were missing.

dialogue.user: That's not very helpful. Is there anyone I can speak to who can provide more details on what was missing? I need to understand this so I don't make the same mistake again.
dialogue.agent: I understand you're looking for more details. However, the loan record does not contain information about why the credit application was considered incomplete, nor does it provide contact information for further discussion on this matter.

dialogue.user: This is quite frustrating. Since it was denied due to an incomplete application, what would be the next steps if I wanted to reapply?
dialogue.agent: The loan record does not contain information regarding the process for reapplying or any steps to take after a denial due to an incomplete application.

dialogue.user: <Dissatisfied> I'm very unhappy with this interaction. I understand that the application was denied, but the reasons provided are vague, and there's no information on how to rectify the situation or reapply. I feel like I haven't received any useful information to help me move forward.
